actions.command:

actions.description: Run final public contract and service health checks
actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
printf ready > "$work/health.expected"
printf v2 > "$work/version.expected"
printf alpha-original > "$work/alpha.expected"
printf beta-original > "$work/beta.expected"

check_body() {
  local url=$1 expected=$2 label=$3
  local status
  status=$(curl --silent --show-error --output "$work/$label.actual" --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url")
  test "$status" = 200
  cmp "$expected" "$work/$label.actual"
}
check_body http://127.0.0.1:8080/health "$work/health.expected" public-health
check_body http://127.0.0.1:8080/version "$work/version.expected" public-version
check_body http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-alpha-73c "$work/alpha.e…

actions.description: Stress-check the public v2 route for stable availability
actions.command:
set -e
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  test "$(curl --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:8080/health)" = ready
  test "$(curl --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:8080/version)" = v2
  test "$(curl --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-alpha-73c)" = alpha-original
done
printf '%s\n' '100 consecutive public health/version/existing-record checks: PASS'
test "$(cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream)" = '8082'
test "$(sqlite3 /var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3 'select count(*) from records;')" = 2
printf '%s\n' 'final upstream and record-count checks: PASS'
